analytic_result.theorem: Every rank-perfect simplicial-claw-free graph is hbar-perfect.
analytic_result.proof: BETA satisfies every induced-subgraph rank inequality by the SCF rank theorem; rank-perfectness identifies their intersection with STAB; the universal reverse inclusion STAB subset BETA gives equality.
analytic_result.semi_line_corollary: Every SCF semi-line graph is hbar-perfect, using the classical rank-perfectness of semi-line graphs.

strict_witness.interpretation: rank-perfect SCF, but neither line nor h-perfect

sampled_circular_arc_stress.method: seeded equal-length circular-arc graphs conditioned on at most 120 stable sets; Qhull discovery with exact integer validity and affine-rank checks for every reported rank facet

proved: strict finite separation from line and h-perfect classes
not_proved: all SCF quasi-line graphs are rank-perfect
